res_all = ser.groupby(key, observed=False).all()

any_dtype = str(res_any.dtype)
all_dtype = str(res_all.dtype)

probe("all_dtype", all_dtype)

probe("all_C", res_all.iloc[c_pos])

# Also record the full vectors for cross-checking
probe("any_values", res_any.to_numpy().tolist())
probe("all_values", res_all.to_numpy().tolist())
